title: Follow-up: pin the root-only scope of the review-worktree ignore
description: Nits 1 and 2 of the DEC-183 review of opum-ai/glyph-cli#66 (GCLI-15), recorded verbatim on GCLI-15. (1) The discovery test does not pin that the ignore only matches at the root: `.claude/worktrees/` has a slash before the end so it matches relative to the root .gitignore, and the trailing slash means directories only, so `src/.claude/worktrees/x.ts` and `pkg/.claude/worktrees/` stay visible. If someone rewrote the line as `**/.claude/worktrees/` or `worktrees/`, this test would still pass. Add a `nested/.claude/worktrees/a.ts` fixture that must stay listed. (2) The fixture is a plain directory; a real worktree has a `.git` gitfile at its root, which Git may treat as a nested repository. The ignore excludes the path either way, but the test does not reproduce the real worktree layout, while the live measurement does.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The discovery test lists `nested/.claude/worktrees/a.ts`, pinning that the ignore matches only at the root and that a wider pattern such as `**/.claude/worktrees/` would be caught.
The fixture reproduces a review worktree closely enough to exercise Git's treatment of its `.git` gitfile, or the test states why it cannot and the live case is covered elsewhere.
